caption: The drawing consists of a regular grid made up of faint horizontal and vertical lines, forming small squares across the page. Over this grid, there is a repeating geometric pattern composed of darker blue lines. The primary motif is a series of large circular forms, each enclosing a smaller cross or plus sign made up of four squares. These circles intersect at the corners, sharing sections of their outlines, and are arranged in a regimented, row-and-column composition. In the spaces between the circles, there are rectangular forms outlined in the same blue, each containing a vertical arrangement of five squares. In the lower left corner of the page, there is a smaller version of the grid with only the basic outlines of the main pattern elements sketched in blue, showing only the underlying structure of the full design. The background of the entire sheet is a plain beige or off-white color. There is a small inscription in the bottom right corner.
title: Homespun Quilt
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
